audience: sales and customer teams who keep contacts and companies in Pobuca Connect

useCases.title: Find a contact with their company and phones
useCases.text: The AI looks up a contact and reads phone numbers, emails, addresses, team, tags and custom fields, then opens the contact's organization.

useCases.title: Find contacts changed in the last days
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts with a filter on the update time, newest first, so you see who was added or edited lately.

useCases.title: List companies of an industry and their main contacts
useCases.text: The AI lists organizations filtered by industry or type, and opens each for its addresses and primary contact.

useCases.title: Add a contact or a company
useCases.text: The AI searches first to avoid a duplicate, then creates a new contact or organization with the details you give.

useCases.title: Update a contact or a company
useCases.text: The AI looks the record up, then changes only the fields you name, such as phone, email, tags or custom fields.

useCases.title: Check teams, members and custom fields
useCases.text: The AI lists the teams that own and share contacts, who belongs to each team with their role, and the custom fields defined for contacts and organizations.
